predictions: I would be upset with the 15-8 that I posted last week, but it turns out that is my average weekly record this season. And after that dying thud of a 12-win week the Wednesday before, 15 feels like a bonanza. That brings me to 146-83 for the season (63.8% correct), with most of the real success coming from A, E, F and G divisions. In B/C/D divs., I'm a flat 50-50 through ten weeks, which is a pretty ambivalent record… but I'm not at all ambivalent in my assessment of that performance.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Hump Day! @ Bad Mutha Duckas. Even if they were to lose a close one here, the Ducks would still be in control of the E race. But if Hump Day can drop a few extra points on them here, this is a dead dang heat heading into the last three weeks. Alas, I still feel like the Ducks are the team to beat in E, and they win, 14-10.

Match #2: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Uber took out Serious last week, and the B race has just re-exploded. The only thing it's missing is a Matt's Tab win last week, which would have made for a FOUR-way pile-up at 7-3. Instead, Matt's Tab now has to fight back up by picking off two of the three ahead of them now. Sadly for them, I think Blindsided is ready to get a little payback instead, 13-11.

Match #3: (C Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Nine Lives. The Niners have won four of their last five, and are only one loss behind the division-leading Show Me. While a Niners win here would make for a great story, shoving the C into further chaos, I just can't bring myself to pick a team in a top match with a losing cricket record. Show Me, 15-9.

Match #4: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Dart Attack. As noted above in the match #2 writeup, last week's loss by Serious has created a nutso B race. And now they have to face one of the RDL's most habitual "close match" teams, meaning this is quite likely to go the distance. I think Serious will escape, but it's never easy against Attack. 13-11.

Match #5: (F Div.) Village Idiots @ Dart Side of the Moon. The Idiots' title hopes took a serious turn last week, losing to the only team ahead of them in the F standings. Now they have to face one of the most dangerous 0.500 teams in the league. I'm going to stick with the Idiots in this one, but if it went the other I wouldn't be surprised. Idiots, 14-10.

Match #6: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Red-eye Rangers. How the Rangers won three in a row but then lost to the last place team is beyond me… and sums up D division in a nutshell. Will the division-leading Bandits be able to escape them? I guess so, 14-10.

Match #7: (C Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Darty Sanchez. Over the past five weeks, the only loss either of these teams has had is a stomping at the hands of Show Me. Both are still very much in the race for 2nd (& 1st for Trippin!), and I think Trippin keeps hope alive, 13-11.

Match #8: (G Div.) Punk in Drublic @ Runs with Corks. Is this where the Corks start to lock up a top-two finish? Or is this where Punk jumpstarts the race for 2nd again? Punk won this matchup the first time around, but I think I'm feeling the Corks this time, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Lunatic Fringe. This one probably isn't a big factor in the A race, but it very much could give us a read on how close the 5th place A team is to making a move on the revered top half of A. Fringe establishes order, 15-9.
Match #10: (C Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Shooter McGavin. Is this a head-to-head battle to decide a bottom-two finish (and the possible drop to D that goes with it)? Stumble Out takes this, 14-10.
Match #11: (E Div.) Y.N.T.A. @ Irish Ton. Given the loss totals and points in the E race, this one very well could be a showdown to determine who finishes in E's bottom-two. How is YNTA here? 15-9.

Match #12: (D Div.) DD-214 @ BullsHit. Like the two matches above this match, this one could be a big player in determining who drops to E next season. But in D, even a bottom match could play a role in the title chase. Craziness. BullsHit with the upset! 13-11.
